COLLECTION_OPERATION.set_insertion_rule: ADD/APPEND value TO a collection explicitly initialised as EMPTY SET becomes CALL add_to_set(collection, value); compiler emits set.add(value)

branches.PROMPT_ONLY: INPUT(STRING(prompt)) does not determine the receiver type
branches.RETURNING_SCOPE_PARAMETER: input-bound variable in a returning top-level computation becomes an ACCEPTS parameter
branches.INDEXED_LIST_EVIDENCE: LENGTH/index usage establishes list semantics independently of the prompt
branches.COHERENT_SCOPE_PARAMETERS: all top-level INPUT-bound dependencies become ACCEPTS parameters when the same coherent scope exposes OUTPUT or RETURN

branches.INFER_SEMANTIC_TYPE: infer data structure from downstream usage
branches.PROMOTE_TO_PARAMETER: preserve known structured dependency without inventing external serialisation
branches.PRESERVE_EXPLICIT_INPUT: retain input when semantic structure remains weak
branches.INFER_ENCODING: only when delimiter/serialisation evidence is explicit
branches.DO_NOT_INFER_ENCODING: semantic structure is known but encoding is not
branches.AMBIGUOUS_INPUT_STRUCTURE: record conflicting or insufficient structural evidence
branches.APPLY_DETERMINISTIC_CONVERSION: apply a lossless type conversion when downstream usage uniquely determines it
branches.STRING_TO_LIST_OF_CHARACTER: text input indexed by position and traversed by LENGTH becomes a character list without delimiter inference
branches.OBJECT_DEPENDENCY_WRAPPER: bare input used as an existing object dependency is promoted to a wrapper parameter when downstream property usage makes textual encoding unjustified
branches.NUMERIC_TYPE_FROM_USAGE: downstream arithmetic overrides the generic STRING input default when numeric semantics are structurally established
branches.INTEGER_INPUT: integer-specific operations select INT/INTEGER input semantics

INPUT_RESOLUTION.principle: semantic structure and external encoding are scored independently

branches.MISSING_FUNCTION_NAME: introduce a neutral function identifier only when structure requires a name
branches.MISSING_COLLECTION_NAME: introduce a neutral collection identifier only when source omits one
branches.RESERVED_KEYWORD_ESCAPE: preserve source identifier using __reserved_keyword__ prefix rather than semantic renaming
branches.RESOLVE_ANONYMOUS_DECLARATION_FROM_USAGE: resolve an unnamed structure declaration to a later identifier only when compatible downstream usage uniquely identifies that structure

GENERIC_IDENTIFIER.audit_requirement: every introduced generic identifier must record why the source required one

branches.TRANSPOSE_IN_PLACE: TRANSPOSE <matrix> becomes an in-place transpose operation

branches.REDUNDANT_MATRIX_DIMENSION: preserve conceptual N x N intent in audit while omitting unused N from executable wrapper when Matrix alone drives transpose and row traversal

CONTROL_FLOW.termination_rule: Treat STOP as semantic termination intent, not a fixed keyword synonym: clear loop-only termination may lower to BREAK; termination of a compatibility-generated wrapper representing the whole algorithm lowers to value-less RETURN; genuine top-level termination retains runtime termination semantics; ambiguous cases are not guessed.
